select s.boss_id,s.boss_name,s.boss_phone,GROUP_CONCAT(s.name SEPARATOR ',') as name from market_stall s where s.boss_name is not null
and s.name like concat('%',#{param.name},'%')
and s.bossName like concat('%',#{param.bossName},'%')
GROUP BY s.boss_name order by s.name desc

insert into market_stall( id,code,name,type,area,location,built_up_area, practical_area,dept_id,dept_name, lease_type,leased,bim_bind,remark,enabled, tenant,deleted,create_by,creator_id,creator_type,create_time,update_by,updater_id,updater_type,update_time) values
(#{item.id},#{item.code},#{item.name},#{item.type},#{item.area},#{item.location},#{item.builtUpArea}, #{item.practicalArea},#{item.deptId},#{item.deptName}, #{item.leaseType},#{item.leased},#{item.bimBind},#{item.remark},#{item.enabled}, #{item.tenant},#{item.deleted},#{item.createBy},#{item.creatorId},#{item.creatorType},#{item.createTime},#{item.updateBy},#{item.updaterId},#{item.updaterType},#{item.updateTime})
on duplicate key update code = values(code), name = values(name), type = values(type), dept_id = values(dept_id), dept_name = values(dept_name), area = values(area), enabled = values(enabled), deleted = values(deleted), update_time = values(update_time)
